channel.title: The Oral Torah & Rabbinic Authority — Dayan Daniel Kada
channel.description: Dayan Daniel Kada's shiurim on the Oral Torah, the authority of the Hakhamim, Daat Torah and Ruah HaKodesh.
channel.itunes:author: Dayan Daniel Kada

item.title: Must You Follow the Sanhedrin When It Is Wrong? | Oral Torah & Rabbinic Authority
item.description:
Must we follow the Beit Din HaGadol even when it is wrong? Lo Tasur: Rashi and the Ramban say yes, even if they call right left, while the Rambam, from the Yerushalmi, says a true hakham who knows they erred may not follow. Also the Ramban's reasons and why the Gemara binds us.

item.title: Do Rabbis Today Have Authority? | Oral Torah & Rabbinic Authority
item.description:
Do rabbis today carry the authority of Lo Tasur? The Rambam limits it to the Sanhedrin, while the Ran and Sefer HaHinukh extend it to the great hakhamim of each generation. The Ramban says it excludes rabbinic enactments. The shiur also considers political instructions and whether there is psak on hashkafa.

item.title: What Makes Someone a Gadol? | Oral Torah & Rabbinic Authority
item.description:
Who qualifies as a talmid hakham, a dayan or a Gadol HaDor? The class sets out the criteria for each, including the Rambam's seven qualities for a dayan, then asks what Emunat Hakhamim really requires and how to relate to disputes among the great.

item.title: Do Rabbis Rule by Ruah HaKodesh? | Oral Torah & Rabbinic Authority
item.description:
Does a prophet have any special authority in halacha? The class compares the Rambam, for whom he has none, with the Kuzari and the Raavad on divine assistance, and the Ramhal's distinctions between prophecy, Ruah HaKodesh, intuition and dreams.
